name: earthbits
title: Earthbits • New Media Artist
tagline: Exploring the intersection of nature and technology
about: Earthbits is a multi-disciplinary artist working in a wide range of media such as 3D modeling, animation, and sound. Her work emphasizes our ability to co-create with the natural world. Through immersive animated works, she invites viewers into conversation with the environment, offering a unique perspective on the intersection of art, technology, and nature.

She uses emerging technologies to investigate new ways to be in connection with our surroundings. Recent works include creating 3D models of local flora, animating them, and co-creating music with plants. The works are projected on surfaces and in virtual spaces. With time spent in nature integral to her process, the possibility emerges to embrace the creative potential of our natural surroundings.
